players.product: OSAT (memory packaging) - package substrate buyer (Simmtech 'Big 5' packaging customer)

quarterly_data.signal: 3Q26 and onward outlook by business (deck): DRAM - memory industry demand continues to significantly exceed supply and customers keep maximizing fab output, which helps maintain high utilization of assembly and final test capacity; in automotive, memory and storage content is expected to increase with higher levels of autonomy. NAND & SSD - driven by continued AI demand, overall SSD and NAND backend demand is expected to remain strong in Q3; smartphone demand may be affected by rising memory prices, but overall performance is expected to remain solid. Logic - sustained demand for high-end FC-BGA packaging, the successive production of new products and an optimized mix are expected to keep the logic packaging business growing steadily in Q3; driven by tight demand and rising raw material costs, most customers have gradually accepted pricing adjustments, expected to further support overall gross margin. Subsidiaries: Tera Probe / TeraPower (combined) expect Q3 revenue to keep growing on strong server and ML/AI demand, with consumer DRAM and consumer logic demand up slightly and automotive flat; Greatek expects AI and HPC to keep driving bumping and flip-chip packaging demand, with consumer-electronics and industrial inventories back at healthy levels and improved forecast visibility. The company is also monitoring energy-price swings driven by the US-Iran conflict and the impact of US interest-rate policy on the semiconductor industry.

Logic packaging (deck): in advanced FC-BGA, PTI has mass-production capability for large-size FC-BGA multi-chip modules (MCMs) supporting package sizes of up to 78 × 75 mm, and will ramp volume production of large-die (1× reticle size) packages in the third quarter. 2Q26 business overview: logic shipments kept rising, with revenue up QoQ and double digits YoY; Tera Probe / TeraPower kept investing capex for customer needs, with revenue up double digits QoQ and YoY; Greatek's revenue grew double digits QoQ and YoY on high customer demand; eSSD demand and shipments kept growing, with quarterly revenue up QoQ and YoY.
quarterly_data.figure: FC-BGA MCM packages up to 78 × 75 mm in mass production; 1× reticle large-die packages ramping in Q3
